def registration_plan(application):
    """Use the receiving application's maintained host, with one active GIS owner."""
    host = application / 'install_extensions.py'

                 'operator/web/app.mjs': browser_source,
                 'operator/web/index.html': index_source}, None, 'legacy')
    if host.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('The maintained extension installer is a symbolic link')
    registry = application / 'operator/extension_registry.py'
    if not registry.is_file():
        raise ValueError('Receive the current complete extension host with install_extensions.py')
    registry_body = registry.read_bytes()
    if b'def file_reply(' not in registry_body or b'def _member_path(' not in registry_body:
        raise ValueError('Receive the maintained extension host with nested member file routes')
    body = host.read_bytes()
    # This is an installed application module, never source supplied by a GIS ZIP.
    namespace = {'__name__': '_upstate_gis_current_extension_installer', '__file__': str(host)}
    exec(compile(body, str(host), 'exec'), namespace)
    if not callable(namespace.get('patch_server')) or not callable(namespace.get('patch_app')):
        raise ValueError('The current extension installer lacks its source composition API')
    transform = {
        'operator/server.py': lambda value: namespace['patch_server'](legacy_server_source(value)),
        'operator/web/app.mjs': lambda value: namespace['patch_app'](legacy_browser_source(value)),
        'operator/web/index.html': legacy_index_source,

def instruction_source(existing, source):
    """Carry current owner instructions while retaining receiver-specific content."""
    body = source.decode('utf-8').strip()
    if not body:
        raise ValueError('The application owner instruction file is empty')
    text = existing.decode('utf-8') if existing is not None else ''
    if body in text:
        return existing
    start = '<!-- BEGIN GIS application owner instructions -->'
    end = '<!-- END GIS application owner instructions -->'
    block = start + '\n' + body + '\n' + end
    if start in text or end in text:
        if text.count(start) != 1 or text.count(end) != 1 or text.index(end) < text.index(start):
            raise ValueError('Retain and reconcile the existing GIS owner instruction boundaries')
        first = text.index(start)
        last = text.index(end) + len(end)
        text = text[:first] + block + text[last:]
    elif not text.strip():
        text = body + '\n'
    else:
        text = text.rstrip() + '\n\n' + block + '\n'
    return text.encode('utf-8')


def install(application, source, dry_run=False):
    application, source = Path(application).resolve(strict=True), Path(source).resolve(strict=True)
    if not (application / 'model/workspace.py').is_file():
        raise ValueError('Receive the original scientific application before this additive component')
    transform, dependencies, integration = registration_plan(application)
    before={};planned={}
    for name, fn in transform.items():
        path=application/name
        if path.is_symlink(): raise ValueError('Original registration file is a symbolic link')
        before[name]=path.read_bytes();planned[name]=fn(before[name].decode('utf-8')).encode('utf-8')
    instruction = application / 'AGENTS.md'
    if instruction.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('Application owner instruction destination is a symbolic link')
    before['AGENTS.md'] = instruction.read_bytes() if instruction.exists() else None
    planned['AGENTS.md'] = instruction_source(before['AGENTS.md'], (source / 'AGENTS.md').read_bytes())
    for name in OWN_FILES:
        data=(source/name).read_bytes();target=application/name
        if target.is_symlink(): raise ValueError('Component destination is a symbolic link')
        before[name]=target.read_bytes() if target.exists() else None
        # This installer is intentionally the owner of these named additive files.
        planned[name]=data
    for name, data in planned.items():
        if name.endswith('.py'): compile(data,str(application/name),'exec')
    changes=[name for name in planned if planned[name]!=before[name]]
    result={'schema':'upstate.gis-installation/v1','application':str(application),'dry_run':dry_run,
            'integration':integration,
            'files':[{'path':name,'before_sha256':sha(before[name]) if before[name] is not None else None,
                      'sha256':sha(planned[name]),'bytes':len(planned[name])} for name in changes]}
    if dry_run or not changes:return result
    # A shared original owner can inspect/undo exact registration edits from this journal.
    journal=application/'source_tools'/'gis-installations'
    journal.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    operation=sha(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True).encode())
    record=journal/(operation+'.json')
    staged={};applied=[]
    try:
        for name in changes:
            path=application/name;path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent,prefix='.gis-install-',delete=False) as out:
                out.write(planned[name]);out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno());staged[name]=Path(out.name)
        # Compare all predecessors immediately before committing any registration changes.
        for dependency, expected in (dependencies or {}).items():
            if dependency.read_bytes() != expected:
                raise ValueError('Concurrent extension host change: ' + str(dependency))
        for name in changes:
            p=application/name
            actual=p.read_bytes() if p.exists() else None
            if actual!=before[name]:raise ValueError('Concurrent original source change: '+name)
        for name in changes:
            p=application/name
            actual=p.read_bytes() if p.exists() else None
            if actual!=before[name]:raise ValueError('Concurrent original source change: '+name)
            if before[name] is not None:
                backup=journal/(operation+'-'+name.replace('/','__')+'.before')
                backup.write_bytes(before[name])
            os.replace(staged[name],p);applied.append(name)
        record.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    except BaseException:
        for name in reversed(applied):
            p=application/name
            if p.read_bytes()!=planned[name]:continue
            if before[name] is None:p.unlink()
            else:
                with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=p.parent,prefix='.gis-rollback-',delete=False) as out:
                    out.write(before[name]);out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno());temporary=Path(out.name)
                os.replace(temporary,p)
        raise
    finally:
        for p in staged.values():p.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return result


def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

    p.add_argument('--source-root',default=str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
    p.add_argument('--dry-run',action='store_true')

from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
from . import gis_project as gis


SOURCE_METADATA_FIELDS = (
    "provenance", "webmap_source", "scientific_metadata", "geography_basis",
    "original_fields", "field_vintages", "format", "columns", "column_units",
    "source_format", "source_crs", "encoding", "decoded_bytes", "decoded_sha256",
    "community_metadata",

def _artifact(workspace, directory, item):
    """Translate the original describe_file contract without altering its identity."""
    path = gis.checked(directory, item)
    result = {"path": path.relative_to(workspace.root).as_posix(),
              "bytes": item["bytes"], "sha256": item["sha256"]}
    return result


def _raster_companions(workspace, item):
    import rasterio
    result = []
    primary = gis.local(workspace.root, item["path"])
    with rasterio.open(primary) as src:
        for filename in src.files:
            p = Path(filename).resolve(strict=True)
            if p == primary:
                continue
            if not p.is_relative_to(workspace.root):
                raise ValueError("Raster companion is outside the retained Workspace")
            result.append(gis.record(workspace.root, p))
    return result


def source_layer(workspace, selection: dict) -> dict:
    collection = selection["source_collection_id"]
    source_id = selection["source_id"]
    path, entry = workspace.source_file(collection, source_id)
    native = Path(entry["body"].get("view_path", entry["body"]["filename"]))
    view = path
    for _ in native.parts:
        view = view.parent
    primary = gis.record(workspace.root, path)
    if primary["sha256"] != entry["body"]["sha256"] or primary["bytes"] != entry["body"]["bytes"]:
        raise ValueError("Original source view identity differs")
    companions = []
    for body in entry.get("companions", []):
        p = view / body.get("view_path", body["filename"])
        rec = gis.record(workspace.root, p)
        if rec["sha256"] != body["sha256"] or rec["bytes"] != body["bytes"]:
            raise ValueError("Original source companion identity differs")
        companions.append(rec)
    row = {"id": selection.get("id", "source:"+collection+":"+source_id),
           "title": selection.get("title", entry["title"]), "kind": entry["kind"],
           "file": primary, "companions": companions,
           "group": selection.get("group", "Original source layers"),
           "units": selection.get("units", entry.get("units", "source attributes")),
           "purpose": selection.get("purpose", entry.get("purpose") or ("categorical" if entry.get("role") == "NLCD" else "context")),
           "source": {"collection_id": collection, "id": source_id, "title": entry["title"],
                      "uri": entry["uri"], "vintage": entry["vintage"],
                      "sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"], "role": entry.get("role"),
                      "units": entry.get("units"), "conversion": entry.get("conversion"),
                      "received_gis":entry.get("received_gis")},
           "visible": selection.get("visible", False)}
    # Keep explicit scientific metadata with the portable originals and working layer.
    # These are the retained source's own values, not inferred units or geography.
    for key in SOURCE_METADATA_FIELDS:
        if key in entry:
            row["source"][key] = deepcopy(entry[key])
    for key in ("layer", "where", "band", "metric", "direction"):
        if key in selection:
            row[key] = selection[key]
        elif key in ("layer", "metric", "direction") and entry.get(key) is not None:
            row[key] = entry[key]
    return row


DELIVERY_ADAPTER_VERSION = "delivery-gis-project/v1"


def _delivery_state(workspace, delivery_id):
    import re
    if not isinstance(delivery_id, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", delivery_id):
        raise ValueError("Choose an original completed delivery identity")
    path = gis.local(workspace.root, "deliveries/" + delivery_id + "/delivery-state.json")
    directory = path.parent
    original = gis.record(workspace.root, path)
    value = gis.load(path)
    if (value.get("schema") != "upstate.delivery/v1" or value.get("id") != delivery_id
            or value.get("state") != "complete"):
        raise ValueError("Complete the selected delivery before preparing its editable GIS project")
    return directory, value, original


def delivery_layers(workspace, delivery_id):
    """Translate the captured delivery datasets into the existing GIS request."""
    directory, state, original = _delivery_state(workspace, delivery_id)
    dataset_set = state.get("gis_datasets")
    if (not isinstance(dataset_set, dict)
            or dataset_set.get("schema") != "upstate.atlas-datasets/v1"
            or dataset_set.get("delivery_id") != delivery_id
            or not isinstance(dataset_set.get("datasets"), list)
            or not dataset_set["datasets"]):
        raise ValueError("Build the current delivery edition with its map-dataset catalogue before GIS export")
    declared = {}
    for item in [*state.get("files", {}).values(), *state.get("maps", {}).values()]:
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or not {"path", "bytes", "sha256"} <= item.keys():
            raise ValueError("The delivery has an incomplete original file descriptor")
        previous = declared.get(item["path"])
        if previous and any(previous[key] != item[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")):
            raise ValueError("The delivery repeats a member with conflicting original identities")
        declared[item["path"]] = item
    captured = {}
    def capture(item):
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("Select an original declared delivery member")
        actual = declared.get(item.get("path"))
        if actual is None or any(item.get(key) != actual[key] for key in ("bytes", "sha256")):
            raise ValueError("GIS dataset refers to a different or undeclared delivery member")
        if actual["path"] not in captured:
            captured[actual["path"]] = _artifact(workspace, directory, actual)
        return captured[actual["path"]]
    files = state["files"]
    atlas_descriptor = capture(files["map_atlas_index"])
    atlas = gis.load(gis.local(workspace.root, atlas_descriptor["path"]))
    if (atlas.get("schema") != "upstate.map-atlas/v1"
            or atlas.get("delivery_id") != delivery_id
            or atlas.get("datasets") != dataset_set
            or atlas.get("grid_id") != dataset_set["grid_id"]):
        raise ValueError("The original atlas and delivery datasets describe different selections")
    datasets = {row["id"]: row for row in dataset_set["datasets"]}
    if len(datasets) != len(dataset_set["datasets"]):
        raise ValueError("Choose distinct original delivery dataset identities")
    relationships = {key: [] for key in datasets}
    for page in atlas["pages"]:
        capture(page["file"])
        for number, panel in enumerate(page["panels"], 1):
            link = panel.get("dataset")
            if not isinstance(link, dict) or link.get("id") not in datasets:
                raise ValueError("Every atlas panel must select a retained delivery dataset")
            row = datasets[link["id"]]
            if (link.get("file") != row["file"] or link.get("metadata") != row["metadata"]
                    or link.get("companions") != [value["file"] for value in row["companions"]]
                    or panel["units"] != row["units"]
                    or bool(panel.get("signed")) != row["signed"]):
                raise ValueError("An atlas panel differs from its original GIS dataset")
            relationships[row["id"]].append({
                "map_key": page["map_key"], "family": page["family"],
                "panel": number, "title": panel["title"],
                "display_scale": panel.get("display_scale"),
                "overlays": page["overlays"],
            })
    if any(not value for value in relationships.values()):
        raise ValueError("A retained delivery dataset has no original map relationship")
    grid = workspace.get_grid(dataset_set["grid_id"])
    if grid["grid"] != atlas["grid"]:
        raise ValueError("The delivery atlas differs from its original prepared grid")
    attachment_id = "delivery-context:" + delivery_id
    layers = []
    for dataset_id, row in datasets.items():
        if (row.get("schema") != "upstate.atlas-dataset/v1"
                or row["grid_id"] != grid["id"]
                or row["baseline_run_id"] != atlas["baseline_run_id"]):
            raise ValueError("A delivery dataset belongs to another original grid or baseline")
        if sorted(row["maps"], key=lambda item: (item["map_key"], item["panel"])) != sorted(
                relationships[dataset_id], key=lambda item: (item["map_key"], item["panel"])):
            raise ValueError("The original dataset and atlas map relationships differ")
        kind = row["kind"]
        if kind not in {"baseline_export", "scenario_difference", "relative_priority",
                        "receptor_priority", "receiving_water_priority"}:
            raise ValueError("Choose a supported original delivery dataset quantity")
        signed = kind == "scenario_difference"
        if bool(row["signed"]) != signed:
            raise ValueError("The dataset subtraction direction differs from its retained quantity")
        runs = row["runs"]
        if (not runs or runs[0]["id"] != atlas["baseline_run_id"]
                or (signed and len(runs) != 2)):
            raise ValueError("The dataset has incomplete original producing-run identities")
        selected_run = runs[-1] if signed else runs[0]
        if signed and (selected_run["id"] not in atlas["scenario_run_ids"]
                       or row["derivation"].get("direction") != "alternative minus baseline"):
            raise ValueError("Choose the retained alternative-minus-baseline dataset")
        purpose = "difference" if signed else "physical" if kind == "baseline_export" else "priority"
        scenario = selected_run["scenario"]
        # Priority normalizations/footprints remain separate scientific metrics.
        # Full-native physical/difference ranges retain the existing shared policy.
        metric = (row["pollutant"] if purpose in {"physical", "difference"}
                  else "delivery-priority:" + gis.fingerprint({
                      "kind": kind, "support": row["support"], "derivation": row["derivation"]}))
        source = {"kind": "original completed delivery dataset",
                  "delivery_id": delivery_id, "delivery_state": original,
                  "atlas_index": atlas_descriptor, "context_attachment_id": attachment_id,
                  "dataset": deepcopy(row)}
        layers.append({
            "id": "delivery:" + delivery_id + ":" + dataset_id,
            "title": row["title"] + (" · " + scenario["title"] if signed else ""),
            "kind": "raster", "file": capture(row["file"]),
            "companions": [capture(value["file"]) for value in row["companions"]],
            "group": ("Signed changes · " + scenario["title"] if signed else
                      "Current annual exports" if purpose == "physical" else "Selected export priorities"),
            "purpose": purpose, "metric": metric, "units": row["units"],
            "run_id": selected_run["id"], "scenario_id": scenario["id"],
            "profile_id": row["profile_id"],
            **({"direction": "alternative minus baseline"} if signed else {}),
            "visible": kind == "baseline_export" and row.get("pollutant") == "nitrogen_export",
            "source": source,
        })
        capture(row["metadata"])
    # Retain original extent geometry as its own editable context, never as a
    # substitute for the native reporting-mask support of each raster.
    grid_root = workspace.root / "grids" / grid["id"]
    for role in ("model_domain", "reporting_area"):
        item = grid["files"][role]
        layers.append({
            "id": "delivery-grid:" + delivery_id + ":" + role,
            "title": role.replace("_", " ").capitalize(), "kind": "vector",
            "file": _artifact(workspace, grid_root, item), "layer": role,
            "group": "Original model and reporting extent", "purpose": "context",
            "units": "source geometry", "visible": role == "reporting_area",
            "source": {"delivery_id": delivery_id, "grid_id": grid["id"],
                       "role": role, "spec": grid["spec"], "original_artifact": item},
        })
    # The original maps, metadata and numerical data are one common-root
    # attachment. Existing ../../ FGDC links still resolve after independent
    # receiving. Self-contained PDF reports travel with that same hierarchy.
    for name in ("map_atlas", "map_atlas_csv", "map_atlas_sources", "native_execution",
                 "native_grid_record", "display_scales"):
        capture(files[name])
    for item in files.values():
        if str(item["path"]).lower().endswith(".pdf"):
            capture(item)
    documents = [atlas_descriptor] + [captured[key] for key in sorted(captured)
                                     if key != files["map_atlas_index"]["path"]]
    attachment = {
        "id": attachment_id, "title": "Original delivery maps, datasets, metadata and PDF reports",
        "kind": "document", "file": documents[0], "companions": documents[1:],
        "source": {
            "kind": "complete original atlas dataset and map context",
            "delivery_id": delivery_id, "delivery_state": original,
            "baseline_run_id": atlas["baseline_run_id"],
            "scenario_run_ids": atlas["scenario_run_ids"], "grid_id": grid["id"],
            "atlas_index": atlas_descriptor, "dataset_ids": list(datasets),
            "retained_members": list(sorted(captured)),
            "attachment_scope": "Original atlas/index, datasets, FGDC XML, actual companions, maps, native/grid provenance and self-contained PDF reports.",
            "source_archive_descriptors": {name: files[name] for name in
                ("working_archive", "delivery_archive") if name in files},
        },
    }
    # Detect a changed record while its selected member identities were captured.
    gis.checked(workspace.root, original)
    return {
        "layers": layers, "attachments": [attachment], "grid": grid,
        "binding": {"version": DELIVERY_ADAPTER_VERSION, "delivery_id": delivery_id,
                    "delivery_state": original, "atlas_index": atlas_descriptor,
                    "grid_id": grid["id"], "dataset_ids": list(datasets),
                    "baseline_run_id": atlas["baseline_run_id"],
                    "scenario_run_ids": atlas["scenario_run_ids"],
                    "context_attachment_id": attachment_id},
    }


def delivery_choices(workspace):
    """Compact chooser metadata; numerical files are verified inside export."""
    result = []
    for path in sorted((workspace.root / "deliveries").glob("*/delivery-state.json")):
        value = gis.load(path)
        if value.get("schema") != "upstate.delivery/v1" or value.get("id") != path.parent.name:
            raise ValueError("The original delivery catalogue has a different identity")
        dataset_set = value.get("gis_datasets") or {}
        atlas = value.get("atlas") or {}
        eligible = (value.get("state") == "complete"
                    and dataset_set.get("schema") == "upstate.atlas-datasets/v1"
                    and dataset_set.get("delivery_id") == value["id"]
                    and bool(dataset_set.get("datasets")))
        result.append({
            "id": value["id"], "state": value.get("state"),
            "title": value.get("selection", {}).get("title") or atlas.get("title") or value["id"][:12],
            "eligible": eligible, "dataset_count": len(dataset_set.get("datasets") or []),
            "map_count": atlas.get("map_count", 0), "grid_id": atlas.get("grid_id"),
            "project_crs": (atlas.get("grid") or {}).get("crs_name") or (atlas.get("grid") or {}).get("crs"),
            "reason": ("" if eligible else "Complete the current delivery edition with its map-dataset catalogue."),
        })
    return result


def request(workspace, selection: dict) -> dict:
    """Select retained source editions, prepared grids and completed run artifacts.

    A source-only selection is fully usable before model execution. A selected run
    must be complete. No invented native-stage unit mappings are supplied here.
    """
    layers, attachments, grid_ids, run_ids = [], [], [], []
    delivery = delivery_layers(workspace, selection["delivery_id"]) if selection.get("delivery_id") else None
    if delivery is not None:
        layers.extend(delivery["layers"])
        attachments.extend(delivery["attachments"])
    source_selections = list(selection.get("sources", []))
    collection_id = selection.get("source_collection_id")
    if collection_id and not source_selections:
        source_selections = [{"source_collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": e["id"]}
                             for e in workspace._get("sources", collection_id)["entries"]]
    source_selections = [{**item, "source_collection_id": item.get("source_collection_id") or collection_id}
                         for item in source_selections]
    # Adopted working layers always retain their attached originals, licences and
    # edition provenance, including when the operator selected only GIS layers.
    selected_pairs={(x["source_collection_id"],x["source_id"]) for x in source_selections}
    for cid in dict.fromkeys(x["source_collection_id"] for x in source_selections):
        if not cid:continue
        collection=workspace._get("sources",cid)
        context_groups={e.get("gis_context_group") for e in collection["entries"]
                        if (cid,e["id"]) in selected_pairs and e.get("gis_context_group")}
        for entry in collection["entries"]:
            if entry.get("gis_required_context") and entry.get("gis_context_group") in context_groups and (cid,entry["id"]) not in selected_pairs:
                source_selections.append({"source_collection_id":cid,"source_id":entry["id"]})
                selected_pairs.add((cid,entry["id"]))
    for item in source_selections:
        if not item["source_collection_id"]:
            raise ValueError("Select the retained source collection for every source")
        row = source_layer(workspace, item)
        (layers if row["kind"] in {"vector", "raster"} else attachments).append(row)
    if selection.get("grid_id"):
        grid_ids.append(selection["grid_id"])
    if selection.get("baseline_run_id"):
        run_ids.append(selection["baseline_run_id"])
    run_ids.extend(selection.get("scenario_run_ids", []))
    if len(set(run_ids)) != len(run_ids):
        raise ValueError("Select each retained run once")
    runs = []
    for index, run_id in enumerate(run_ids):
        state = workspace.inspect_run(run_id)
        if state["state"] != "complete":
            raise ValueError("Finish the selected run before including its physical results: "+run_id)
        case = workspace._get("scenarios", state["selection"]["scenario_id"])
        profile = workspace._get("profiles", state["selection"]["profile_id"])
        run_directory = workspace.root / "runs" / run_id
        prefix = "Baseline" if index == 0 and selection.get("baseline_run_id") else "Case"
        for metric, item in state["artifacts"].items():
            if Path(item["path"]).suffix.lower() not in {".tif", ".tiff"}:
                continue
            if not item.get("units"):
                raise ValueError("Retained model artifact lacks declared physical units: "+metric)
            rec = _artifact(workspace, run_directory, item)
            layers.append({"id":"run:"+run_id+":"+metric,
                           "title":metric.replace("_", " ").capitalize()+" · "+case["title"],
                           "kind":"raster", "file":rec, "companions":_raster_companions(workspace, rec),
                           "group":prefix+" · "+case["title"]+" · "+run_id[:10],
                           "purpose":"physical", "metric":metric, "units":item["units"],
                           "run_id":run_id, "scenario_id":case["id"], "profile_id":profile["id"],
                           "visible":index == 0 and metric == "nitrogen_export",
                           "source":{"kind":"original completed model artifact", "artifact":item,
                                     "run_selection":state["selection"], "runtime":state.get("runtime", {}),
                                     "scenario":case, "profile":profile}})
        if "landcover" in state.get("stages", {}):
            item=state["stages"]["landcover"]["artifact"]
            rec=_artifact(workspace,run_directory,item)
            layers.append({"id":"scenario-landcover:"+run_id,"title":"Land cover · "+case["title"],
                           "kind":"raster","file":rec,"companions":_raster_companions(workspace,rec),
                           "group":prefix+" · "+case["title"]+" · "+run_id[:10],
                           "purpose":"categorical","units":item.get("units","class"),
                           "scenario_id":case["id"],"run_id":run_id,"visible":False})
        grid_ids.append(state["selection"]["grid_id"])
        runs.append({"id":run_id,"selection":state["selection"],"scenario_title":case["title"],
                     "profile_title":profile["title"],"runtime":state.get("runtime",{})})
    grids=[]
    for grid_id in dict.fromkeys(grid_ids):
        grid=workspace.get_grid(grid_id)
        grids.append(grid)
        if not selection.get("include_grid", True):
            continue
        directory=workspace.root/"grids"/grid_id
        for role,item in grid["files"].items():
            ext=Path(item["path"]).suffix.lower()
            if ext not in {".tif",".tiff",".gpkg"}:
                continue
            rec=_artifact(workspace,directory,item)
            kind="vector" if ext==".gpkg" else "raster"
            row={"id":"grid:"+grid_id+":"+role,"title":role.replace("_"," ").capitalize(),
                 "kind":kind,"file":rec,"group":"Prepared study grid · "+grid_id[:10],
                 "units":item.get("units","source geometry" if kind=="vector" else None),
                 "purpose":"categorical" if role in {"NLCD","reporting_mask"} else "context",
                 "source":{"kind":"original prepared grid","grid_id":grid_id,"role":role,
                           "input":grid.get("inputs",{}).get(role),"spec":grid["spec"]},
                 "visible":role=="reporting_area"}
            if kind=="raster":
                row["companions"]=_raster_companions(workspace,rec)
            else:
                row["layer"]=role
            layers.append(row)
    # Explicit existing comparison results: preserve their actual sign convention.
    for comparison_id in selection.get("comparison_ids", []):
        if not isinstance(comparison_id,str) or not __import__('re').fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}",comparison_id):
            raise ValueError("Select a retained comparison identity")
        directory=workspace.root/"comparisons"/comparison_id
        comparison=gis.load(directory/"comparison.json")
        if comparison["id"]!=comparison_id:
            raise ValueError("Comparison identity differs")
        for alternative in comparison["alternatives"]:
            for metric,item in alternative["artifacts"].items():
                rec=_artifact(workspace,directory,item)
                layers.append({"id":"comparison:"+comparison_id+":"+alternative["run_id"]+":"+metric,
                    "title":metric.replace("_"," ").capitalize()+" change · "+alternative["run_id"][:10],
                    "kind":"raster","file":rec,"companions":_raster_companions(workspace,rec),
                    "group":"Signed changes · "+comparison_id[:10],"purpose":"difference",
                    "metric":metric,"units":item["units"],"direction":comparison["direction"],
                    "run_id":alternative["run_id"],"profile_id":alternative["selection"]["profile_id"],
                    "scenario_id":alternative["selection"]["scenario_id"],"visible":False,
                    "source":{"comparison_id":comparison_id,"baseline_run_id":comparison["baseline_run_id"],
                              "profile_changed":alternative.get("profile_changed")}})
    if not layers:
        raise ValueError("Choose actual source layers, a prepared grid or completed runs")
    project_crs=selection.get("project_crs")
    if not project_crs and delivery is not None:
        project_crs=delivery["grid"]["grid"]["crs"]
    if not project_crs and grids:
        # Read the real retained reference rather than assuming a grid-JSON spelling.
        import rasterio
        grid=grids[0]
        path=gis.checked(workspace.root/"grids"/grid["id"],grid["files"]["NLCD"])
        with rasterio.open(path) as src:
            project_crs=src.crs.to_string()
    if not project_crs:
        raise ValueError("Select the GIS project's display CRS for a source-only handover")
    focus=selection.get("focus_layer_id")
    if not focus:
        focus=next((l["id"] for l in layers if l["id"].endswith(":reporting_area")),None)
    if not any(l.get("visible") for l in layers):
        layers[0]["visible"]=True
    result={"schema":gis.REQUEST_SCHEMA,"title":selection.get("title",workspace.project["title"]+" · editable GIS"),
            "project_crs":project_crs,"layers":layers,"attachments":attachments,
            "provenance":{"project_id":workspace.project["id"],"project_title":workspace.project["title"],
                          "runs":runs,"grid_ids":list(dict.fromkeys(grid_ids +
                              ([delivery["grid"]["id"]] if delivery is not None else []))),
                          "source_collection_ids":list(dict.fromkeys(x["source_collection_id"] for x in source_selections)),
                          "notes":selection.get("notes",[]),
                          **({"delivery":delivery["binding"]} if delivery is not None else {})}}
    if focus:
        result["focus_layer_id"]=focus
    return result


def export(workspace, selection: dict, *, progress=None) -> dict:
    spec=request(workspace,selection)
    key=gis.fingerprint({"request":spec,"builder_version":gis.VERSION})
    folder=workspace.root/"gis-exports"/key
    folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    gis.save(folder/"selection.json",selection)
    result=gis.build(spec,workspace.root,folder/"project",progress=progress)
    archive=gis.pack(folder/"project",folder/"editable-gis.zip")
    value={"schema":"upstate.gis-export/v1","id":key,"state":"complete",
           "project_id":workspace.project["id"],"title":spec["title"],"result":result,
           "archive":gis.record(workspace.root,folder/"editable-gis.zip"),
           "open":(folder/"project"/"OPEN_GIS.html").relative_to(workspace.root).as_posix(),
           "project":(folder/"project"/"project.qgz").relative_to(workspace.root).as_posix()}
    gis.save(folder/"export.json",value)
    return value


def catalogue(workspace) -> dict:
    """Small, direct operator inventory; no complete source objects on every refresh."""
    sources=[]
    for collection in workspace.sources():
        sources.append({"id":collection["id"],"title":collection["title"],
                        "entries":[{k:e.get(k) for k in ("id","title","kind","role","units","gis_context_group","gis_required_context")}
                                   for e in collection["entries"]]})
    runs=[]
    for path in sorted((workspace.root/"runs").glob("*/run.json")):
        r=gis.load(path)
        runs.append({"id":r["id"],"state":r["state"],"selection":r["selection"],
                     "artifacts":[{"id":k,"units":v.get("units")} for k,v in r.get("artifacts",{}).items()]})
    exports=[gis.load(p) for p in sorted((workspace.root/"gis-exports").glob("*/export.json"))]
    return {"schema":"upstate.gis-catalogue/v1","project_id":workspace.project["id"],
            "sources":sources,"runs":runs,"exports":exports,
            "deliveries":delivery_choices(workspace)}


def received(workspace, receipt_id: str):
    """Read the original retained receiving record and its complete unchanged edition."""
    from .common import identifier
    parent=workspace.root/'gis-received'/identifier(receipt_id)
    value=gis.load(parent/'receipt.json')
    if value.get('id')!=receipt_id or value.get('project_id')!=workspace.project['id'] or value.get('state')!='complete':
        raise ValueError('Choose a complete GIS receiving from this scientific Workspace')
    result=gis.verify(parent/'project')
    if result['fingerprint']!=value['result']['fingerprint']:
        raise ValueError('Receive the newly sealed edition before adopting edited GIS files')
    return parent,value,result


def receive(workspace, archive: str | Path, *, source_upload_id: str | None=None) -> dict:
    """One receiving writer for the original Operator and the installed Workspace CLI."""
    import json
    import zipfile
    archive=Path(archive).resolve(strict=True)
    original=gis.record(archive.parent,archive)
    key=gis.fingerprint({'schema':'upstate.gis-receiving/v1','project_id':workspace.project['id'],
                         'archive_sha256':original['sha256']})
    parent=workspace.root/'gis-received'/key
    parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    root=parent/'project'
    with gis.locked(parent/'.receiving.lock'):
        if root.exists():

from __future__ import annotations

SCHEMA = "upstate.gis-edition-review/v1"
VERSION = "received-gis-review/v1"
WINDOW = 512


def _id(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", value):
        raise ValueError("Choose an original retained GIS identity")
    return value


def _plain(value):
    if hasattr(value, "__geo_interface__"):
        return _plain(value.__geo_interface__)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return {str(k): _plain(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [_plain(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, bytes):
        return {"binary_base64": base64.b64encode(value).decode("ascii")}
    if isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
        return {"nonfinite": str(value)}
    if value is None or isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)):
        return value
    if hasattr(value, "item"):
        return _plain(value.item())
    if hasattr(value, "isoformat"):
        return {"type": type(value).__name__, "value": value.isoformat()}
    return {"type": type(value).__name__, "value": str(value)}


def _json(value):
    return json.dumps(_plain(value), ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True,
                      separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)


def _project(workspace, kind, key):
    key = _id(key)
    prefix = "gis-exports" if kind == "export" else "gis-received"
    name = "export.json" if kind == "export" else "receipt.json"
    path = gis.local(workspace.root, prefix + "/" + key + "/" + name)
    record = gis.load(path)
    if (record.get("id") != key or record.get("project_id") != workspace.project["id"]
            or record.get("state") != "complete"):
        raise ValueError("Choose a complete GIS edition from this original Workspace")
    root = path.parent / "project"
    result = gis.verify(root, native=False)
    if result["fingerprint"] != record["result"]["fingerprint"]:
        raise ValueError("The retained GIS working edition differs from its original record")
    manifest = gis.load(root / "project.json")
    expected = gis.fingerprint({"request": manifest["source_request"],
                                "builder_version": manifest["builder_version"]})
    if expected != manifest["selection_id"] or result["selection_id"] != expected:
        raise ValueError("The GIS selection differs from its original request")
    if result["edition_id"] != record["result"]["edition_id"]:
        raise ValueError("The GIS edition differs from its retained result")
    return root, record, manifest, gis.record(workspace.root, path), result


def _pair(workspace, selection):
    original = _project(workspace, "export", selection["export_id"])
    received = _project(workspace, "received", selection["receipt_id"])
    before, after = original[2], received[2]

    if len(left) != len(before["layers"]) or len(right) != len(after["layers"]) or left.keys() != right.keys():
        raise ValueError("GIS layer identities differ from the original exported selection")
    for key, row in left.items():
        other = right[key]

            if row["data"].get(name) != other["data"].get(name):

    binding = {"schema": SCHEMA + "/selection", "version": VERSION,
               "project_id": workspace.project["id"], "export_id": original[1]["id"],

def _vector(before_root, before, after_root, after, folder):
    import fiona

    from shapely.geometry import shape
    field = before["data"]["source_identity_field"]
    database = folder / "features.sqlite"

    headers = []

            with fiona.open(gis.local(root, row["working_path"]), layer=row["data"]["layer"]) as src:

                                _json(feature["geometry"])))

                   SUM(CASE WHEN edition=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n0,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN edition=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n1
                   FROM features WHERE identity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY identity""")
        db.execute("CREATE UNIQUE INDEX counts_identity ON counts(identity)")
        crs_equal = CRS.from_user_input(headers[0]["crs"]) == CRS.from_user_input(headers[1]["crs"])

                  "coordinates_changed": 0, "geometry_changed": 0, "geometry_unpaired": 0,
                  "geometry_errors": 0, "added": 0, "removed": 0,

        field_changes = {}

        with (folder / "changes.jsonl").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as output, \

            writer = csv.DictWriter(csvfile, fieldnames=["change", "identity", "before_fid", "after_fid",
                                                        "changed_fields", "coordinates_changed",
                                                        "geometry_equivalent", "geometry_status"])
            writer.writeheader()

                output.write(_json(value) + "\n")
                writer.writerow({"change": value["change"], "identity": value.get("identity"),
                    "before_fid": (value.get("before") or {}).get("fid"),
                    "after_fid": (value.get("after") or {}).get("fid"),
                    "changed_fields": _json(value.get("changed_fields", [])),
                    **value.get("geometry_change", {})})

                    sample.append({key: value.get(key) for key in
                                   ("change", "identity", "changed_fields", "geometry_change")})
            query = """SELECT a.identity,a.fid,a.props,a.geom,b.fid,b.props,b.geom
                       FROM counts c JOIN features a ON a.identity=c.identity AND a.edition=0
                       JOIN features b ON b.identity=c.identity AND b.edition=1
                       WHERE c.n0=1 AND c.n1=1 ORDER BY a.ordinal"""
            for identity, oldfid, oldprops, oldgeom, newfid, newprops, newgeom in db.execute(query):
                counts["paired"] += 1
                p0, p1, g0, g1 = json.loads(oldprops), json.loads(newprops), json.loads(oldgeom), json.loads(newgeom)
                fields = [key for key in sorted(p0.keys() | p1.keys())
                          if key not in p0 or key not in p1 or _json(p0[key]) != _json(p1[key])]
                coordinate_change = oldgeom != newgeom
                geometry_status, equivalent = "same coordinates", True
                if not crs_equal:
                    geometry_status, equivalent = "different CRS; geometry unpaired", None
                    counts["geometry_unpaired"] += 1
                elif coordinate_change:
                    try:
                        equivalent = g0 is None and g1 is None
                        if g0 is not None and g1 is not None:
                            equivalent = bool(shape(g0).equals(shape(g1)))
                        geometry_status = "topologically equivalent" if equivalent else "geometry changed"
                        counts["geometry_changed"] += not equivalent
                    except Exception as exc:
                        equivalent, geometry_status = None, "geometry comparison error: " + type(exc).__name__
                        counts["geometry_errors"] += 1
                if not fields and not coordinate_change and crs_equal:
                    counts["unchanged"] += 1
                    continue
                counts["changed"] += 1
                counts["attributes_changed"] += bool(fields)
                counts["coordinates_changed"] += coordinate_change
                for key in fields:
                    field_changes[key] = field_changes.get(key, 0) + 1
                emit({"change": "updated", "identity": identity, "changed_fields": fields,
                      "geometry_change": {"coordinates_changed": coordinate_change,
                          "geometry_equivalent": equivalent, "geometry_status": geometry_status},
                      "before": {"fid": oldfid, "properties": p0, "geometry": g0},
                      "after": {"fid": newfid, "properties": p1, "geometry": g1}})
            query = """SELECT f.edition,f.identity,f.fid,f.props,f.geom,c.n0,c.n1
                       FROM features f LEFT JOIN counts c ON f.identity=c.identity
                       WHERE f.identity IS NULL OR c.n0!=1 OR c.n1!=1

            for edition, identity, fid, props, geometry, n0, n1 in db.execute(query):

                      "identity_occurrences": {"exported": n0 or 0, "received": n1 or 0},

                          {"fid": fid, "properties": json.loads(props), "geometry": json.loads(geometry)}})
        return {"method": "Exact source identity; full attributes; coordinate and topological geometry comparison.",
                "headers": {"exported": headers[0], "received": headers[1]}, "crs_equal": crs_equal,
                "counts": counts, "changed_fields": field_changes, "sample": sample,

               for src, band in ((a, band0), (b, band1))):
            return {**result, "comparison": "unpaired complex-valued band"}
        scale0, offset0 = a.scales[band0-1], a.offsets[band0-1]
        scale1, offset1 = b.scales[band1-1], b.offsets[band1-1]
        if not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in (scale0, offset0, scale1, offset1)):
            raise ValueError("The original raster has a nonfinite scale or offset")
        numeric = units_equal and before.get("purpose") != "categorical" and after.get("purpose") != "categorical"
        counts = {"cells": a.width*a.height, "common_valid": 0, "added_valid": 0, "removed_valid": 0,
                  "neither_valid": 0, "exported_nonfinite_unmasked": 0, "received_nonfinite_unmasked": 0,
                  "raw_changed_common": 0, "physical_changed_common": 0}
        stats = {"count": 0, "minimum": None, "maximum": None, "mean": 0.0, "rms": 0.0}
        counts["unrepresentable_difference_cells"] = 0
        decimal_cells = 0
        profile = {"driver": "GTiff", "width": a.width, "height": a.height, "count": 1,
                   "crs": a.crs, "transform": a.transform, "compress": "deflate",
                   "tiled": True, "blockxsize": WINDOW, "blockysize": WINDOW}
        support_path = folder / "support-change.tif"
        delta_path = folder / "value-change.tif"
        delta = rasterio.open(delta_path, "w", **profile, dtype="float64", nodata=float("nan")) if numeric else None
        try:
            with rasterio.open(support_path, "w", **profile, dtype="uint8") as support:
                support.update_tags(meaning="0 neither finite-valid; 1 both finite-valid; 2 added finite-valid; 3 removed finite-valid",
                                    direction="received minus exported")
                if delta:
                    delta.update_tags(units=str(after["data"]["units"]), direction="received minus exported",
                                      support="common finite-valid cells with a representable float64 received-minus-exported difference")
                for row in range(0, a.height, WINDOW):
                    for col in range(0, a.width, WINDOW):
                        window = Window(col, row, min(WINDOW, a.width-col), min(WINDOW, a.height-row))
                        old, new = a.read(band0, window=window, masked=True), b.read(band1, window=window, masked=True)
                        om, nm = np.ma.getmaskarray(old), np.ma.getmaskarray(new)
                        of, nf = np.isfinite(old.data), np.isfinite(new.data)
                        ov, nv = (~om)&of, (~nm)&nf
                        common, added, removed = ov&nv, (~ov)&nv, ov&(~nv)
                        counts["common_valid"] += int(common.sum())
                        counts["added_valid"] += int(added.sum())
                        counts["removed_valid"] += int(removed.sum())
                        counts["neither_valid"] += int((~ov&~nv).sum())
                        counts["exported_nonfinite_unmasked"] += int((~om&~of).sum())
                        counts["received_nonfinite_unmasked"] += int((~nm&~nf).sum())
                        # Python numeric comparison avoids unsafe int64/uint64 promotion
                        # when a recipient changes the native encoding.
                        unequal = (old.data != new.data if old.dtype == new.dtype else
                                   old.data.astype(object) != new.data.astype(object))
                        counts["raw_changed_common"] += int((common&unequal).sum())
                        codes = np.zeros(old.shape, dtype="uint8")
                        codes[common], codes[added], codes[removed] = 1, 2, 3
                        support.write(codes, 1, window=window)
                        if numeric:
                            old_values, new_values = old.data[common], new.data[common]
                            unsafe_integer = any(np.issubdtype(v.dtype, np.integer) and
                                any(abs(int(x)) > 2**53 for x in (v.min(), v.max()))
                                for v in (old_values, new_values) if v.size)
                            accurate_scalar = (unsafe_integer or scale0 != scale1 or offset0 != offset1)
                            if accurate_scalar:
                                # Decimal represents every native integer and each binary64
                                # scale/offset exactly. 5000 digits exceed the exponent span of
                                # products and differences of finite binary64 inputs.
                                from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
                                numeric_values = np.empty(old_values.size, dtype="float64")
                                changed = 0
                                with localcontext() as context:
                                    context.prec = 5000
                                    def number(value):
                                        return Decimal(int(value)) if isinstance(value, np.integer) else Decimal.from_float(float(value))
                                    ds0, ds1 = Decimal.from_float(scale0), Decimal.from_float(scale1)
                                    do = Decimal.from_float(offset1)-Decimal.from_float(offset0)
                                    for i, (x, y) in enumerate(zip(old_values, new_values)):
                                        difference_value = number(y)*ds1-number(x)*ds0+do
                                        changed += difference_value != 0
                                        rounded = float(difference_value)
                                        if not math.isfinite(rounded) or (rounded == 0 and difference_value != 0):
                                            numeric_values[i] = np.nan
                                            counts["unrepresentable_difference_cells"] += 1
                                        else:
                                            numeric_values[i] = rounded
                                decimal_cells += int(old_values.size)
                            else:
                                # Cancel identical offsets first; multiplying the native
                                # difference avoids loss from a large shared offset.
                                with np.errstate(over="ignore", invalid="ignore", under="ignore"):
                                    raw_difference = new_values.astype("float64")-old_values.astype("float64")
                                    numeric_values = raw_difference*scale0
                                changed_mask = (old_values != new_values) & (scale0 != 0)
                                changed = int(changed_mask.sum())
                                unrepresentable = (~np.isfinite(numeric_values)) | ((numeric_values == 0)&changed_mask)
                                # A finite physical difference can exist even when the raw
                                # subtraction overflows. Recover those cases exactly.
                                if unrepresentable.any():
                                    from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
                                    with localcontext() as context:
                                        context.prec = 5000
                                        ds = Decimal.from_float(scale0)
                                        for i in np.flatnonzero(unrepresentable):
                                            x, y = old_values[i], new_values[i]
                                            dx = Decimal(int(x)) if isinstance(x,np.integer) else Decimal.from_float(float(x))
                                            dy = Decimal(int(y)) if isinstance(y,np.integer) else Decimal.from_float(float(y))
                                            exact = (dy-dx)*ds
                                            rounded = float(exact)
                                            numeric_values[i] = rounded if math.isfinite(rounded) and not (rounded == 0 and exact != 0) else np.nan
                                            decimal_cells += 1
                                    counts["unrepresentable_difference_cells"] += int((~np.isfinite(numeric_values)).sum())
                            counts["physical_changed_common"] += changed
                            difference = np.full(old.shape, np.nan, dtype="float64")
                            difference[common] = numeric_values
                            delta.write(difference, 1, window=window)
                            values = numeric_values[np.isfinite(numeric_values)]
                            if values.size:
                                prior, total = stats["count"], stats["count"]+int(values.size)
                                low, high = float(values.min()), float(values.max())
                                stats["minimum"] = low if stats["minimum"] is None else min(stats["minimum"], low)
                                stats["maximum"] = high if stats["maximum"] is None else max(stats["maximum"], high)
                                magnitude = float(np.max(np.abs(values)))
                                mean = float((values/magnitude).mean())*magnitude if magnitude else 0.0
                                rms = math.sqrt(float(np.square(values/magnitude).mean()))*magnitude if magnitude else 0.0
                                stats["mean"] = stats["mean"]*(prior/total) + mean*(values.size/total)
                                stats["rms"] = math.hypot(stats["rms"]*math.sqrt(prior/total),
                                                          rms*math.sqrt(values.size/total))
                                stats["count"] = total
                result["physical_precision"] = {
                    "method": "Equal offsets cancel before arithmetic; unequal encodings/scales use exact Decimal inputs; final delta storage is float64.",
                    "decimal_evaluated_cells": decimal_cells,
                    "unrepresentable": "Nonzero differences below float64 or overflowing its range are explicitly counted and stored as NoData; exact change counts and native sources remain retained."}
        finally:
            if delta:
                delta.close()
        count = stats["count"]
        result.update(comparison="paired native cells", counts=counts,
                      support="support-change.tif", support_codes={"0": "neither valid", "1": "common valid",
                          "2": "added valid", "3": "removed valid"})
        if numeric:
            result["value_change"] = "value-change.tif"
            result["difference"] = {"direction": "received minus exported", "units": after["data"]["units"],
                "valid_cells": count, "minimum": stats["minimum"], "maximum": stats["maximum"],
                "mean": stats["mean"] if count else None,
                "rmse": stats["rms"] if count else None}
        else:
            counts.pop("physical_changed_common", None)
            counts.pop("unrepresentable_difference_cells", None)
            result["physical_comparison"] = "Raw category/encoding changes and valid support; arithmetic differences are not assigned across categories or different units."
        return result


def _members(root, layer):
    """All actual working-directory companions, not just the primary TIFF hash."""
    path = layer["working_path"]
    prefix = str(Path(path).parent).replace("\\", "/") + "/"
    inv = gis.load(root / "inventory.json")
    if layer["data"]["kind"] == "raster":
        return [row for row in inv["files"] if row["path"] == path or row["path"].startswith(prefix)]
    return [row for row in inv["files"] if row["path"] == path
            or row["path"].startswith(path+"-") or row["path"].startswith(path+".")]


def _report_html(report):
    esc = lambda value: html.escape(str(value), quote=True)
    rows = []
    for row in report["layers"]:
        details = row["comparison"]
        counts = details.get("counts") or {}
        summary = "; ".join(key.replace("_", " ") + ": " + str(value) for key, value in counts.items())
        if details.get("comparison"):
            summary = details["comparison"] + "; " + summary
        difference = details.get("difference")
        if difference is not None:
            summary += "; received minus exported: minimum " + str(difference["minimum"]) + ", maximum " + str(difference["maximum"])
            summary += ", mean " + str(difference["mean"]) + ", RMSE " + str(difference["rmse"])
            summary += " " + str(difference["units"]) + "; representable difference cells: " + str(difference["valid_cells"])
        if details.get("reason") or details.get("physical_comparison"):
            summary += "; " + (details.get("reason") or details["physical_comparison"])
        if row.get("metadata_changed"):
            summary += "; metadata changed: " + ", ".join(row["metadata_changed"])
        links = " ".join('<a href="'+esc(rec["path"])+'">'+esc(Path(rec["path"]).name)+'</a>'
                         for rec in row["files"])
        rows.append("<tr><th>"+esc(row["title"])+"</th><td>"+esc(row["kind"])+"</td><td>"+esc(row["units"])+"</td><td>"+
                    esc(summary or details.get("comparison") or details.get("method"))+"</td><td>"+links+"</td></tr>")
    return """<!doctype html><html lang="en"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width">

<h1>"""+esc(report["title"])+"""</h1><p>Received working edition compared with its explicitly selected retained original export. Vector changes retain full row records. Raster differences use the selected logical band on the exact same native grid; support changes are separate. Open review.json for complete headers, units, source identities, methods and ambiguity counts.</p>
<p>Export <code>"""+esc(report["selection"]["export_id"])+"""</code><br>Receipt <code>"""+esc(report["selection"]["receipt_id"])+"""</code><br>Direction: received minus exported.</p>
<p><a href="review.json">Complete review JSON</a> · <a href="layers.csv">Layer summary CSV</a> · <a href="exported-project.json">Original exported manifest</a> · <a href="received-project.json">Received manifest</a></p>
<table><thead><tr><th>Layer</th><th>Kind</th><th>Received units</th><th>Actual changes</th><th>Complete change artifacts</th></tr></thead><tbody>"""+ "".join(rows)+"""</tbody></table>
<p>Original table/document attachments remain in the complete received GIS project. This review adds context to optional source adoption; original source adoption remains available.</p></html>"""


def _folder(workspace, receipt_id, review_id):
    return workspace.root / "gis-received" / _id(receipt_id) / "reviews" / _id(review_id)


def read(workspace, receipt_id, review_id, *, verify_files=True):
    folder = _folder(workspace, receipt_id, review_id)
    state = gis.load(gis.local(workspace.root, (folder/"review-state.json").relative_to(workspace.root).as_posix()))
    if (state.get("schema") != SCHEMA or state.get("id") != review_id or state.get("state") != "complete"
            or state["selection"]["receipt_id"] != receipt_id
            or state["selection"]["project_id"] != workspace.project["id"]
            or gis.fingerprint(state["selection"]) != review_id):
        raise ValueError("Choose a complete original GIS edition review from this Workspace")
    if verify_files:
        for item in state["files"].values():
            gis.checked(folder, item)
    return folder, state


def review(workspace, selection, *, progress=None):
    original, received, binding = _pair(workspace, selection)
    key = gis.fingerprint(binding)
    folder = _folder(workspace, binding["receipt_id"], key)
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with gis.locked(folder / ".review.lock"):
        state_path = folder / "review-state.json"
        old = {}
        if state_path.exists():
            old = gis.load(state_path)
            if old["selection"] != binding:
                raise ValueError("The original GIS review selection changed")
            if old["state"] == "complete":
                return read(workspace, binding["receipt_id"], key)[1]
        state = {"schema": SCHEMA, "id": key, "state": "running", "selection": binding,
                 "title": received[2]["title"] + " · received edition review",
                 "created_at": old.get("created_at") or datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                 "layers": [], "files": {}}
        gis.save(state_path, state)
        try:
            left, right = {x["id"]: x for x in original[2]["layers"]}, {x["id"]: x for x in received[2]["layers"]}
            for index, (layer_id, before) in enumerate(left.items()):
                after = right[layer_id]
                directory = folder / "layers" / before["key"]
                checkpoint = directory / "layer.json"
                if checkpoint.exists():
                    value = gis.load(checkpoint)
                    if value.get("layer_id") != layer_id or value.get("selection") != key:
                        raise ValueError("A retained layer review belongs to a different selection")
                    for rec in value["files"]:
                        gis.checked(folder, rec)
                else:
                    if directory.exists():
                        shutil.rmtree(directory)
                    directory.mkdir(parents=True)
                    compare = _vector if before["data"]["kind"] == "vector" else _raster
                    comparison = compare(original[0], before, received[0], after, directory)
                    # A layer checkpoint becomes reusable only after all actual native
                    # data and mask/sidecar members still match their input inventory.
                    for source_root, source_layer in ((original[0], before), (received[0], after)):
                        for member in _members(source_root, source_layer):
                            gis.checked(source_root, member)
                    value = {"selection": key, "layer_id": layer_id, "title": after["title"],
                        "kind": before["data"]["kind"], "units": after["data"]["units"],
                        "source": deepcopy(before.get("source")),
                        "exported_working_files": _members(original[0], before),
                        "received_working_files": _members(received[0], after),
                        "comparison": comparison,
                        "files": [gis.record(folder, p) for p in sorted(directory.iterdir()) if p.is_file()]}
                    value["working_files_changed"] = value["exported_working_files"] != value["received_working_files"]
                    headers = comparison.get("headers", {})
                    old_header, new_header = headers.get("exported", {}), headers.get("received", {})
                    value["metadata_changed"] = sorted(name for name in old_header.keys() | new_header.keys()
                        if _json(old_header.get(name)) != _json(new_header.get(name)))
                    if before["data"]["units"] != after["data"]["units"]:
                        value["metadata_changed"].append("declared units")
                    gis.save(checkpoint, value)
                state["layers"].append(value)
                gis.save(state_path, state)
                if progress:
                    progress({"phase": "reviewing-gis-edition", "layer_id": layer_id,
                              "completed": index+1, "total": len(left), "review_id": key})
            # Recheck complete original input fingerprints before finishing a review.
            try:
                for root, rec, manifest, descriptor, result in (original, received):
                    gis.checked(workspace.root, descriptor)
                    if gis.verify(root, native=False)["fingerprint"] != result["fingerprint"]:
                        raise ValueError("A retained GIS input changed during review")
            except Exception:
                # A restored input must never cause mixed-input checkpoints from
                # this failed attempt to be reused under the original binding.
                for checkpoint in (folder / "layers").glob("*/layer.json"):
                    checkpoint.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                raise
            gis.save(folder / "exported-project.json", original[2])
            gis.save(folder / "received-project.json", received[2])
            report = {**state, "state": "complete"}
            gis.save(folder / "review.json", report)
            (folder / "REVIEW.html").write_text(_report_html(report), encoding="utf-8")
            with (folder / "layers.csv").open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
                writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=["layer_id", "title", "kind", "units",
                    "working_files_changed", "comparison", "counts"])
                writer.writeheader()
                for row in report["layers"]:
                    writer.writerow({key: row.get(key) for key in
                        ("layer_id", "title", "kind", "units", "working_files_changed")} |
                        {"comparison": row["comparison"].get("comparison", row["comparison"].get("method")),
                         "counts": _json(row["comparison"].get("counts", {}))})
            paths = [p for p in sorted(folder.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()
                     and p.name not in {".review.lock", "review-state.json", "review.zip"}]
            with zipfile.ZipFile(folder / "review.zip", "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, allowZip64=True) as archive:
                for path in paths:
                    archive.write(path, path.relative_to(folder).as_posix())
            state["state"] = "complete"
            state["files"] = {p.relative_to(folder).as_posix(): gis.record(folder, p)
                              for p in [*paths, folder / "review.zip"]}
            gis.save(state_path, state)
            return read(workspace, binding["receipt_id"], key)[1]
        except Exception as exc:
            state["state"] = "failed"
            state["error"] = {"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)}
            gis.save(state_path, state)
            raise


def adoption_context(workspace, receipt_id, review_id, fingerprint):
    folder, state = read(workspace, receipt_id, review_id)
    if state["selection"]["received_fingerprint"] != fingerprint:
        raise ValueError("Choose a review of this exact received working edition")
    return folder, state, {"id": state["id"], "selection": state["selection"],
                          "review": state["files"]["review.json"],
                          "archive": state["files"]["review.zip"]}

        print(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False),file=sys.stderr,flush=True)

def inspect_atlas_styles(layer, expected, *, require_original):
    """Exercise every retained native style, then restore the actual current one."""
    variants = expected.get("atlas_styles", [])
    if not variants:
        return []
    manager = layer.styleManager()
    current = manager.currentStyle()
    observed = []
    try:
        for variant in variants:
            if variant["name"] not in manager.styles():
                if require_original:
                    raise ValueError("A saved atlas style did not load in QGIS: " + variant["name"])
                continue
            if not manager.setCurrentStyle(variant["name"]):
                raise ValueError("QGIS could not select its retained atlas style")
            renderer = layer.renderer()
            style = variant["style"]
            if renderer.type() != "singlebandpseudocolor":
                if require_original:
                    raise ValueError("QGIS did not retain the atlas color ramp")
                continue
            ramp = renderer.shader().rasterShaderFunction()
            entries = ramp.colorRampItemList()
            transparency = renderer.rasterTransparency()
            matches = (ramp.colorRampTypeAsQString() == "INTERPOLATED"
                       and renderer.band() == expected["data"]["band"]
                       and renderer.opacity() == 1 and renderer.alphaBand() == -1
                       and (transparency is None or transparency.isEmpty())
                       and renderer.classificationMin() == style["minimum"]
                       and renderer.classificationMax() == style["maximum"]
                       and not ramp.clip() and len(entries) == len(style["entries"])
                       and all(a.value == b["value"] and a.color.name().lower() == b["color"]
                               and a.color.alpha() == b["alpha"]
                               for a, b in zip(entries, style["entries"])))
            if require_original and not matches:
                raise ValueError("QGIS changed a retained atlas range or palette")
            observed.append({"style_id": variant["id"], "name": variant["name"],
                             "original_legend_matches": matches, "stops": len(entries)})
    finally:
        if not manager.setCurrentStyle(current):
            raise ValueError("Could not restore the selected native QGIS style")
    return observed


def run(directory, output):
    os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
    from qgis.core import (QgsApplication, QgsProject, QgsMapSettings,
                           QgsMapRendererParallelJob, QgsRectangle, Qgis)
    from qgis.PyQt.QtCore import QSize
    from qgis.PyQt.QtGui import QColor
    directory, output = Path(directory).resolve(strict=True), Path(output).resolve()
    before = gis.verify(directory, native=False)
    if output.exists() or output.is_relative_to(directory):
        raise FileExistsError("Choose a new receiving directory outside the sender")
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copytree(directory, output, copy_function=shutil.copyfile)
    app = QgsApplication([], False)
    app.initQgis()
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        project = QgsProject()
        if not project.read(str(output / "project.qgs")):
            raise ValueError("QGIS could not open the editable project")
        manifest = gis.load(output / "project.json")
        expected = {row["key"]: row for row in manifest["layers"]}
        loaded = project.mapLayers()
        if set(loaded) != set(expected):
            raise ValueError("Native QGIS layer identities differ")
        rows = []
        for key, layer in loaded.items():
            if not layer.isValid():
                raise ValueError("Native QGIS layer failed: " + layer.name())
            item = {"id": key, "name": layer.name(), "provider": layer.providerType(),
                    "crs": layer.crs().authid(), "valid": True}
            if expected[key]["data"]["kind"] == "vector":
                item["feature_count"] = layer.featureCount()
                if item["feature_count"] != expected[key]["data"]["feature_count"]:
                    raise ValueError("Native QGIS feature population differs")
            else:
                item.update(width=layer.width(), height=layer.height())
                if (item["width"], item["height"]) != (expected[key]["data"]["width"], expected[key]["data"]["height"]):
                    raise ValueError("Native QGIS raster dimensions differ")
            item["atlas_styles"] = inspect_atlas_styles(layer, expected[key],
                                                        require_original=not manifest.get("history"))
            rows.append(item)
        settings = QgsMapSettings()
        settings.setDestinationCrs(project.crs())
        settings.setBackgroundColor(QColor("white"))
        settings.setOutputSize(QSize(1400, 950))
        settings.setLayers([node.layer() for node in project.layerTreeRoot().findLayers() if node.isVisible()])
        settings.setExtent(QgsRectangle(*manifest["extent"]))
        job = QgsMapRendererParallelJob(settings)
        job.start()
        job.waitForFinished()
        errors = [{"layer_id": item.layerID, "message": item.message} for item in job.errors()]
        if errors:
            raise ValueError("Native QGIS rendering: " + json.dumps(errors))
        if not job.renderedImage().save(str(output / "qgis-native.png")):
            raise OSError("Could not save the native rendering")
        project.setFilePathStorage(Qgis.FilePathType.Relative)
        native_file = output / "project.qgz"
        if not project.write(str(native_file)):
            raise OSError("Native QGIS save failed")
        check = QgsProject()
        if not check.read(str(native_file)) or set(check.mapLayers()) != set(expected):
            raise ValueError("The native saved project did not reopen")
        if any(not layer.isValid() for layer in check.mapLayers().values()):
            raise ValueError("A layer did not reopen from the native saved edition")
        for key, layer in check.mapLayers().items():
            inspect_atlas_styles(layer, expected[key], require_original=not manifest.get("history"))
        import zipfile
        with zipfile.ZipFile(native_file) as archive:
            qgs = [n for n in archive.namelist() if n.endswith(".qgs")]
            if len(qgs) != 1:
                raise ValueError("Expected one native project XML")
            (output / "project.qgs").write_bytes(archive.read(qgs[0]))
        result = {"schema": "upstate.gis-native-receiving/v1", "version": Qgis.QGIS_VERSION,
                  "layer_count": len(rows), "layers": rows, "render_errors": errors,
                  "native_save_reopened": True, "seconds": round(time.monotonic()-started, 6)}
        gis.save(output / "native-receiving.json", result)
        manifest["native_qgis"] = {"status": "opened, rendered, saved and reopened", **result}
        gis.save(output / "project.json", manifest)
        # HTML does not depend on QGIS Python's Fiona/Rasterio installation.
        gis.catalogue(output, manifest)
        gis.inventory(output)
        gis.verify(output, native=False)
        if gis.verify(directory, native=False) != before:
            raise ValueError("Sender changed during native receiving")
        return {**result, "directory": str(output), "sender_unchanged": True}
    except Exception:
        # A failed native receive remains available for diagnosis, with no success record.
        raise
    finally:
        project = None
        app.exitQgis()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("directory")
    parser.add_argument("output")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(run(args.directory, args.output), indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
